title: BEA says each quarter's GDP is estimated three times as source data arrive
summary: BEA says each quarter's GDP is estimated three times as source data arrive.
body: BEA says that for each quarter it estimates GDP three times. The advance estimate, about a month after the quarter ends, uses the best information then available. The second and third estimates incorporate additional source data. The source says: "Why? Because for each quarter, BEA estimates GDP three times." An early GDP number is an estimate scheduled to be revised. Treating the advance print as a final measurement contradicts the procedure BEA describes.
